scope_limits: These are saved completed rows. In-flight/late terminal callbacks may be absent; do not treat374 as a certified whole-process exposure count.

cadence_reference.warning: Logical timestamp-only reference; ignores latest-only overwrites, worker scheduling, event-buffer pruning and unfinished/unsaved terminal calls. No endpoint removed to force equality.

16456.note: Counter reads are bounded and not simultaneous across threads. Does not assign native-pool CPU to inference calls or normalize CPU by these counts.

native_clock.formula: host_ns = qpc * 1e9 / frequency + offset; retain both bounds

SDK_packet_latency.meaning: Parent relay metadata return to child pose_input received marker, causal clock bracket. Excludes any later mailbox/control delay; cannot be transferred to old slow runs.

_read.meaning: Inclusive original method + nested callbacks + observer wall span. Not exclusive CPU, GIL hold time or quantitative causal share.

_send_pose.meaning: Inclusive original method + nested callbacks + observer wall span. Not exclusive CPU, GIL hold time or quantitative causal share.
